newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end narrowly mixed in lethargic trade.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end narrowly mixed in lethargic trade.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed narrowly mixed on Wednesday in lethargic trade due to a lack of positive news to lift the market out of its recent doldrums, brokers said.
The market was likley to continue depressed for several more weeks, they added.
The General Index fell 0.22 percent to 1,420.4 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index edged up 0.10 percent to 1,995.4 points, according to preliminary stock figures.
"Trading continues to be slack and for the moment you can not glimpse any investor interest that could change the trend," said Hernado Pastor of local brokerage T & J.

Intercapital's Lorenzo Wong added that, if anything, the most recent news had been negative because foreign investors were disconcerted by the military's arrest on Tuesday of retired general Rodolfo Robles, who has frequently accused the army and intelligence services of human rights abuses.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru closed down 1.18 percent at 5.03 soles on volume of 1.763 million shares, according to preliminary figures.
Southern Peru Ltd, outperformed the market and closed up 2.56 percent at $16.00 on volume of 37,000 shares.
In a total of 1,199 trades, volume was estimated at 19.8 million soles ($7.7 million).
